title: New Life in the Countryside: Winemakers and Remote Workers
grammar: Counter-concessive and exchange postposition: ellenében ('in exchange for / against')
goal: I can describe the renaissance of rural living through winemaking, agritourism, and remote work.
I can deploy the full set of B2 relational compound postpositions (rovására, javára, függvényében, híján, ellenében).
I can evaluate urban-to-rural migration trends and community revitalization in contemporary Hungary.
